items.html: No auto trigger — an action that runs on arrival (e.g. a perf-test) is the same contract but a later trigger mode, with its own lifecycle questions (when it runs, retry, does it block dispatch, a WAITING(action_pending) self-loop) → later
No rich outcome-condition language — classify_action_result is exit-code / structured-JSON (L2a-style); a general predicate DSL over outputs is later → later
No packaged action library — only the anchor runners (pairflow.git_commit / pairflow.git_merge); a general catalog (publish, notify, perf-test) is later → LC3b

No operator delete — delete_requested is an explicit operator storage/lifecycle intent (a CANCEL sibling) that drives force_release in LC4 (LC2 release minus the declared-boundary gate) — not an emitted boundary and not a workflow action; it + the record purge are → LC4

No action_running recovery / exactly-once — the side effect runs after the CAS claim and before the result commit; a crash in that window leaves a durable action_running (no double-run, since the claim is single-winner), but reconciling a stuck action_running (re-claim, idempotent re-run, watchdog) is later — the same crash-window class as LC2 release → L9
No remote / distributed action proofs — a remote action with verifiable completion (the merge-as-distribution concern) is later → L8 / L10
